facts.fact: Angola's Data Protection Agency (APD) board of directors says it fined MAXAM US$150,000-equivalent for an illegal transfer to the UK, and Banco Comercial do Huambo and UNITEL US$75,000-equivalent each, by deliberations 001-003 of 30 April and 19 June 2024.
The APD's Board of Directors, acting under article 53 of Law 22/11 of 17 June, issued the fining deliberations, so the authority is in post.
The APD says it fined MAXAM, Banco Comercial do Huambo and UNITEL for breaching personal data protection rules under Law 22/11, by deliberations 001-003/2024 of 30 April and 19 June 2024.
The Board of Directors of the Angolan Data Protection Agency issued fining deliberations under article 53(3) of Law 22/11.
Fines imposed on three entities under Law 22/11 of 17 June, cited by the APD as the basis of its deliberations.

AGO.note: The document states nothing on regional digital cooperation.
